thought.text: DDEV project started. Now installing composer dependencies (this will take a while — I'll run in background and poll).

reasoning_content: DDEV started successfully. Next, I'll run `ddev composer install`. This is a big step — it downloads all the Drupal modules. It might take a while, so let me set a long timeout and run it with output captured to a file.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup runuser -u dev -- ddev composer install --no-interaction > /tmp/composer_install.log 2>&1 &
echo "started PID $!"
